profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Adaptable, innovative IT professional with experience providing data-driven, actionable insights and leading projects that solve business problems, enhance system functionality, and improve the user experience. Dynamic individual with cloud computing and data analysis experience on end-user products, systems, and networks. Agile project manager who collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver software development initiatives and strategic plans within deadlines. Driven self-starter who integrates technical acumen with a creative approach to help businesses and customer thrive.

Expertise In:
• Backend Software Development
• Front End Development
• IT Project Management
• Customer Support
• Systems Thinking
• Automated & Manual Testing 
• Code Coverage Tracking
• Data Analysis & Visualization



Technical Tools and Skills

Databases, Programs, & Architecture:	
•  Amazon Web Services (AWS)  
•  Microsoft SQL Server  
•  SharePoint  
•  MS Power Platform 
•  Microsoft Azure  
•  Broadcom Performance Management 
•  eHealth 
•  InfoVista  
•  Elasticsearch 
•  Splunk
•  Oracle PeopleSoft


Programming Languages:	
•  Excel Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)  
•  SQL  
•  Python  
•  Java 
•  JavaScript  
•  HTML 5/CSS 

Application Frameworks:	
• Sencha Ext JS  

General Skills:
• SAFe for Teams (Agile) Framework

positions.title: Computer Scientist | Project Manager Role
positions.description: Spearhead critical projects and programs strategically. Managed Customer Support Portal and engaged with stakeholders to improve the application.  Champion several initiatives, including Microsoft Power platform development, SharePoint site management, and Power BI report management. Remain organized in a dynamic environment and meet all deadlines by working collaboratively.
positions.insights: Skills: SharePoint · MS Power Platform · Java · Microsoft Power BI · HTML5

positions.title: Computer Scientist | Software Developer Role
positions.description: Managed software testing programs for modeling and simulating network devices as well as for traffic scenarios. Drafted business intelligence (BI) reports for technical leaders and site owners. Coded Java webpages, SQL queries, and utilized BIRT BI Java API to aggregate program certification data and site metrics into compelling stories and reports. Wrote test plans, report bugs, track issues, run functional tests on software releases, and provide customer support.  Delivered customer-centric, data-driven changes that worked.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Java · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Test Automation · User Acceptance Testing

positions.title: Student/ IT Intern
positions.description:
To build a realistic agent-based model of a social network to analyze the spread of web applications in those networks; involves research, planning, and software programming; presented work, in a poster, at the IEEE Symposium on Privacy and Security in May 2009, Oakland, CA.

Faculty Advisor: Dr. Mohamed Shehab

company.name: DOD IASP/CyberCorps Research project At UNC Charlotte

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
I was an IT Intern during the summer.  I worked on different programming tasks on software projects, and learned C# along the way.  Visual Studio was the programming IDE used.  Programming tasks include: simple (secondary authentication point) user login authentication using Microsoft Active Directory, and minor programming while creating Encompass forms.  I researched and worked with the Encompass (loan processing) software.  So, I can create Encompass forms, custom print forms, update Encompass settings, and add data to the Encompass server.  I generally know how to use the Encompass software.  

After researching the Encompass software, I gave a presentation on creating forms for it.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project Focus: Visual-based Network Monitoring

Job Duties: Assist in the development/testing of the visual-based network monitoring system; this system detects and responds to Denial-of-Service Attacks before a network's servers are overwhelmed

Faculty Advisor: Professor Gail-Joon Ahn

company.name: UNC Charlotte's Laboratory of Information Integration, Security and Privacy

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Faculty Advisor: Dr. Payton, and Dr. Dahlberg

During the internship, I worked in the Networking and Robotics Lab conducting research in ad-hoc wireless communication in robot teams
